title: How to Create an Analytics Module Provider

types.name: identifier
types.description:
Each analytics provider has a unique ID used to identify it. The provider's ID
will be stored as `aly_{identifier}_{id}`, where `{id}` is the provider's `id`
property in the `medusa-config.ts`.
types.example: class MyAnalyticsProviderService extends AbstractAnalyticsProviderService { static identifier = "my-analytics" // ... }
